Treus is the guardian of the dangerous crystals in the haunted mine below the river Salve, or at least he was until he died - and now it's his spirit that lingers on. This supernatural being has the ability to possess and control objects around him. Luckily in this tower it's 'only' pickaxes any combatant has to worry about.

Quest: Haunted Mine

Combat: The more damaged Treus is the more likely he is to show his cowardly nature and run from you, fading and teleporting away. Hit him to turn him back into his true form. He attacks (when he's not running away) with melee. He is also accompanied by three possessed pickaxes.
